title: Open Coffee places dataset
description: One file per city listing cafés, coffee bars and other places that serve coffee. Part of Roastbook Open Coffee.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

city.description: City slug, matching the file name.

city_name.description: City name in the local language.

tier.title: Specialty tier
tier.description: A: coffee is the core product; the place roasts its own beans or serves named specialty roasters and usually offers filter coffee. B: food or something else leads, but the place serves a specialty roaster. none: not a specialty place (kept in the dataset). unknown: not yet assessed.

serving.title: Serving
serving.description: Coffee preparation offered. true: offered; false: confirmed not offered; absent: unknown.

pour_over.description: Hand-brewed filter (V60, Kalita, Chemex and similar).

batch_brew.description: Filter coffee from a batch brewer.

cold_brew.description: Coffee brewed with cold water over many hours. true: offered; false: confirmed not offered; absent: unknown.

decaf.description: Decaffeinated coffee. true: offered; false: confirmed not offered; absent: unknown.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: true: available; false: confirmed not available; absent: unknown.

wifi.description: Wi-Fi for guests. true: available; false: confirmed not available; absent: unknown.

laptop_friendly.description: Laptops are welcome (no laptop ban, seats with sockets or tables).

kids_friendly.description: Suitable for children, for example with high chairs, space for prams or a kids' menu. true: yes; false: confirmed not suitable; absent: unknown.

dogs_allowed.description: Dogs may come inside. true: allowed; false: confirmed not allowed; absent: unknown.

outdoor_seating.description: Seats outside, such as a terrace or tables on the pavement. true: available; false: confirmed none; absent: unknown.

card_payment.description: Payment by debit or credit card. true: accepted; false: confirmed not accepted; absent: unknown.

cash_only.description: Only cash is accepted. true: cash only; false: other payment methods are accepted; absent: unknown.

focus.description: coffee_led: coffee is the main product; food_led: food or a restaurant concept leads; balanced: both matter equally.

breakfast.description: Breakfast is served. true: served; false: confirmed not served; absent: unknown.

lunch.description: Lunch dishes are served. true: served; false: confirmed not served; absent: unknown.

cakes_baked_in_house.description: Cakes or pastries are baked by the place itself. true: baked in house; false: confirmed bought in; absent: unknown.

instagram.description: Address of the place's own Instagram profile, for example https://www.instagram.com/example.coffee/.

facebook.description: Address of the place's own Facebook page.

xref.title: Identifiers in other datasets
xref.description: Crosswalk to other datasets. google_place_id is the only Google data we may store.

wikidata.description: Wikidata item id of the place, for example Q42.

google_place_id.description: Google Maps place id, stored only so a known place can be matched. No other Google data is stored.

name.description: Name of the roastery whose coffee is served.

roaster_id.description: Reserved for the future Open Coffee roasters dataset.

own.description: The place roasts this coffee itself.

name.description: Name of the award or ranking, for example a national barista championship or a city guide's list.

year.description: Year the award was given, for example 2025.

amount.description: Price paid for one standard drink, in the currency given by currency, for example 3.9.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: The legal entity running the place, taken from its Impressum or legal notice. Only companies and other legal entities; never the name of a natural person (sole traders are omitted).

name.description: Registered name of the company that runs the place, as written in its legal notice.

legal_form.description: For example GmbH, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), KG, e.K.

register_id.description: Commercial register number, for example HRB 123456 (Amtsgericht München).

name.description: The name the place uses on its sign or website.

status.description: open; temporarily_closed (renovation, holiday longer than a month); closed (permanently); unverified (found but not yet confirmed to exist).

merged_into.description: Set when this record turned out to be a duplicate. The record stays as a tombstone so its id is never reused or lost.

last_verified_at.description: When a primary source last confirmed that the place exists with this status.

checked_at.description: When the record as a whole was last reviewed or enriched.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours in OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax (used as a format only; no OSM data), for example "Mo-Fr 08:00-18:00; Sa,Su 09:00-17:00".

description.description: Short English description written only from the facts stored in this record. Never copied from the place's own texts.

roasts_own_beans.description: Whether the place roasts coffee itself. true: roasts its own beans; false: confirmed not roasting; absent: unknown.

sells_beans.description: Whether whole beans or ground coffee are sold to take home. true: sold; false: confirmed not sold; absent: unknown.

sells_equipment.description: Whether brewing equipment such as grinders, drippers or kettles is sold. true: sold; false: confirmed not sold; absent: unknown.

offers_courses.description: Barista courses, brewing classes or public cuppings.

reusable_cup_systems.description: Deposit or reusable cup schemes accepted, for example recup, vytal, own_cup.

prices.description: Prices we observed, each with the date and page where we saw it. Currently only the cappuccino price, as a comparable reference.

external_ratings.description: References to rating pages elsewhere. Rating values are never stored.
